info.description:
Forensic merge of auth/catalog/commerce/general/admin fragments over route:list (529 routes). Scope: uri api/* except api/documentation* and api/oauth2-callback. Auth per request via headers (customer {{customer_token}} / admin {{admin_token}}); collection auth none. General items converted from custom schema; description headings: PURPOSE, ACTOR, AUTHENTICATION, AUTHORIZATION, THROTTLE, CONTROLLER, REQUEST, QUERY, RESPONSES, ERRORS, ENVELOPE, BUSINESS_FLOW, CONSUMERS, EVIDENCE. Unknowns preserved verbatim; no live bodies captured (G10).
